row:
Crystal is an Accredited Massage Therapist having received her massage therapy license from South Bay Massage College in Manhattan Beach, CA, in 2012. After studying massage for 2 years, she graduated with over 1,000 hours of hands-on training and massage experience specializing in Sports Injury, Pre and Post Sports Training, and more.

Crystal has chosen Massage Therapy as her profession because she finds working one-on-one with each client very fulfilling and rewarding. In fact, she says that if you love what you do, you'll never work a day in your life! With a tremendous kindhearted nature she is passionate about helping her clients heal and always be able to perform at their peak level.

Crystal is herself an athlete, competing in martial arts and swimming on an Olympic national level. She has participated in many of Southern California's local 5-10 K races and is training for an upcoming women's fitness competition.
